links.comparator_used: AI available but no prioritization of the reporting worklist (prioritization 'off' days), randomized by day
links.outcome: Time to CT and time to lung cancer diagnosis (primary outcomes); also time to referral, time to treatment, stage at diagnosis
links.effect: Median time to CT 53 days (17-145) vs 53 days (19-141), ratio of geometric means 0.97 (95% CI 0.93-1.02; P = 0.31). Median time to diagnosis 44 days (26-90) vs 46 days (24-105), ratio 0.98 (95% CI 0.83-1.16; P = 0.84). Time to referral 14 vs 15 days (P = 0.13); time to treatment 76 vs 72.5 days (P = 0.99); stage P = 0.34.
links.quote: AI prioritization of CXR requested by UK primary care has no significant impact on the lung cancer pathway.
